name: Jobab
overview: The name Jobab appears in Scripture referring to several individuals, notably a son of Joktan listed among his descendants, highlighting his place within the genealogies of Genesis 10:29. Additionally, Jobab is identified as a king of Edom, succeeding Bela and reigning from Bozrah, as recorded in Genesis 36:33 and 1 Chronicles 1:44. He is also mentioned as a king of Madon in Joshua 11:1, indicating his role in regional leadership during the conquest period. Furthermore, two Benjamites named Jobab are noted, though little is known about them, underscoring the name's occurrence across different tribes and contexts in Scripture.
